message:
## Vulnerability Digest

This DLL component scan used only `DLL_software_component.txt`; the primary product files were not read or combined. Obvious aliases, product-family variants, and duplicates were normalized while preserving the listed versions. The scan window was **2026-10-04 13:10 IST through 2026-10-05 13:10 IST** (**2026-10-04 07:40 UTC through 2026-10-05 07:40 UTC**).

**No credible, newly reported vulnerabilities were found that both fall within the exact 24-hour window and confidently match a listed DLL, library, SDK, or component.**

### Findings

No qualifying findings.

### Freshness and relevance review

- The recent Moment.js path-traversal advisory (CVE-2026-17495) is relevant to the inventory's Moment.js entry, but its authoritative publication date is September 29, 2026, so it was excluded as stale.
- Recent GitHub Advisory Database entries published on October 5 concerned unrelated products such as osCommerce, Keycloak, WordPress add-ons, and small standalone applications; they were excluded as product mismatches.
- The newest surfaced reviewed NuGet, npm, and Maven advisories predated the scan window or did not match the inventory, so no package advisory qualified.
- No ambiguous candidate remained for a "Possible matches needing review" section.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned advisories, CVE/NVD-oriented records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA-oriented reporting.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported within the exact window. MongoDB's official alerts page showed its latest surfaced security entries before this window.

### Sources checked

- [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories?query=sort%3Aupdated-desc)
- [MongoDB security alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)
- [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/en-us/)
- [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog)
- [Moment.js advisory record](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw)

### Review priority

No immediate review is recommended based solely on vulnerabilities newly reported in this 24-hour window. Continue routine monitoring and track older applicable advisories through the existing vulnerability backlog.
